tool_args.rationale: Fit the four parameters of the verified transformed Hill-2 inhibition and linear-bleed law to the five paid observations, then test it on fresh confirmation data.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot spans s_grad from 0.25 to 2.25, so the stated low-span ambiguity does not apply.
The verified Hill mechanism directly accounts for both the sigmoidal onset and sink-gradient inhibition; the alternatives omit the observed gradient dependence.
The verified readout is a present snapshot, so a trajectory batch is not needed to identify temporal dynamics.
